verses.text: When he comes, he will prove the world to be in the wrong about sin.
verses.title: The Holy Spirit’s Work

verses.text: I, even I, am the Lord , and apart from me there is no savior. I have revealed and saved and proclaimed— I, and not some foreign god among you. You are my witnesses,” declares the Lord , “that I am God.
A new command I give you: Love one another. As I have loved you, so you must love one another.
